(1) Western participants agree in applying both familiar and unfamiliar metaphoric pitch mappings in an abstract task and in a musical context, (2) mappings for spatial height are largely independent from those for pitch height, and (3) high pitch is only "better" or "more" in terms of brightness and intensity.

the question of what pitch means, and how pitch is understood in a cross-domain context.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the verticality metaphor is just one of many possible mappings for pitch.
pitch is not only vertically structured but also structured along other dimensions, and that this is reflected in the way we use pitch in music.
the mapping of pitch onto height in Western music is not as ubiquitous and automatic as it has been claimed.
